title: Law of Large Numbers Simulator
approval: User authorized creation of missing planned lessons with autonomous mockup review.
approvedRefinements: Shared components provide canonical navigation, numbered progress and single rail Guide invitation.
Action instructions appear only after a prediction; the raster’s bottom action reminder is omitted.
Actual curves, checkpoint rows and formulas are generated from the seeded engine, not raster geometry.
Chart viewBox uses measured container width to preserve label size with the Guide open.
Exact checkpoint table includes short nonmonotonic examples; bounds remain draws1–10000 and seed1–9999.
